email.subject1: a signal play for Field Materials
email.body1:
Kyle, saw Field Materials closed a $10.5M Series A and is planning to double the team and triple revenue this year.

Scaling pipeline that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals quietly go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Field Materials off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kyle, quick follow-up for Field Materials.

Tripling revenue means the meeting target jumps well ahead of headcount. Most teams don't actually know how many booked meetings that math requires, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Field Materials needs to hit that number this year, and where it breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kyle, last bit of proof for Field Materials.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Field Materials' reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kyle, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A motion? I'll tailor it to Field Materials either way.
